figures.caption: Figure 2: Empirical distribution of 𝑧-statistics for GMV (x-axis) from A/A tests at different traffic levels (Top: 1%, 5%, 10%; Bottom: 20%, 30%). The y-axis represents frequency. Deviations from the standard normal (orange curve) indicate CLT failure.

Figure 1: Distribution of Pre-experiment Raw GMV (total GMV calculated using pre-experiment data at user level). The box plot (x-axis values omitted for confidentiality) shows the median, quartiles, and outliers. The extreme outliers contribute disproportionately to variance, causing statistical instability.
